summary: StrathSpan is a fixed Celtic music trio (fiddler Nora Garver, cellist/fiddler Julia Weatherford, piper/fiddler Cathleen Nixon) based in Asheville/Black Mountain, but the monthly 'Second Sundays @ Archetype' event is not one of their listed concerts. It is described as fiddler Nora Garver bringing 'her friends and fellow Celtic music lovers' for an informal afternoon session at Archetype Brewing every second Sunday, i.e. a recurring, fiddle-led Celtic trad session rather than a ticketed StrathSpan performance.

evidence.note: All 5 listings use near-identical language: 'Nora Garver of StrathSpan joins us with her friends and fellow Celtic music lovers' for an upbeat-but-chill session, recurring monthly since Dec 2025 through Apr 2026, always free, always at Archetype Brewing's taproom.
StrathSpan itself is confirmed as a fixed 3-person touring/performing ensemble (Garver, Weatherford, Nixon) offering concerts and ceilidhs, not an open community or session group.

StrathSpan's own event calendar does not list the Archetype Brewing Second Sundays date at all, indicating this recurring session is a separate, informal side activity led by one member (Garver) rather than an official StrathSpan gig.

The listing text ('friends and fellow Celtic music lovers') plus the tags 'Community', 'Afternoon Session', 'Fiddle Led' point to a trad-session format (multiple musicians playing together, audience of regulars) rather than a ticketed concert or open-mic sign-up format, though no specific returning attendee names are given in the record.
